name: light
description: Private, intelligent browser automation — without sending your screen to the cloud.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @privai/schemas && npm run build -w @privai/shared && npm run build -w @privai/privacy && npm run build -w @privai/vision && npm run build -w @privai/ai-provider && npm run build -w @privai/agent-core
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @privai/extension
